name: Authenticate field engineer

main_scenario.sentence: Field Engineer submits credentials
System validates the submitted credentials
System confirms successful authentication to the Field Engineer

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: credentials are invalid

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Field Engineer that authentication failed

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: authentication service is unavailable

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the Field Engineer of a temporary inability to authenticate

success_guarantee: The Field Engineer is recognized as an authenticated user
minimal_guarantee: No authentication state is retained for the failed attempt
The system remains secure and operational

System presents the retrieved list to the Field Engineer

name: Create inspection report draft
preconditions: Field Engineer has the application installed on the device and is logged into the system
trigger: Field Engineer initiates creation of a new inspection report for an assigned site

main_scenario.sentence: Field Engineer selects an assigned site for inspection
System creates a new inspection report draft linked to the selected site
Field Engineer completes the inspection checklist in the draft report
Field Engineer attaches site photos to the draft report
Field Engineer saves the draft report on the device

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: device storage is insufficient to create a new report

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the engineer of the storage limitation

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: required checklist items are incomplete

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the engineer of the missing items

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: photo attachment fails

handling_steps.sentence: System alerts the engineer that the photo could not be attached
Field Engineer retries attaching the photo

extensions.label: 5a
extensions.condition: device write error prevents saving the draft

handling_steps.sentence: System reports the save failure to the engineer
Field Engineer may retry saving later

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: Field Engineer cancels the report creation

handling_steps.sentence: System discards any partially entered data

success_guarantee: A draft inspection report exists on the device
The draft is linked to the selected site
The draft contains the completed checklist and all attached photos as entered by the engineer
minimal_guarantee: No partial or inconsistent report data remains on the device after a failure
The device remains in a stable state and any temporary data is cleared
The system continues to enforce authentication and data protection guarantees

name: Submit completed inspection report
preconditions: A saved draft inspection report exists for the Field Engineer
trigger: Field Engineer initiates submission of the saved draft inspection report

main_scenario.sentence: Field Engineer requests submission of the draft inspection report
System records the submission of the inspection report
System creates thumbnail images from the report's attached photos
System generates a PDF summary of the submitted inspection report

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: System cannot create thumbnails for one or more attached photos

handling_steps.sentence: System records the thumbnail creation failure for the affected photos and continues processing the rest of the report data
System proceeds to generate the PDF summary of the submitted inspection report

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System cannot record the report submission

handling_steps.sentence: System retries recording the submission of the inspection report
System aborts the submission process after retry failure

success_guarantee: The inspection report is stored as submitted
Thumbnail images exist for all photos that could be processed
A PDF summary of the report is stored
The report is marked as ready for downstream processing
minimal_guarantee: The draft inspection report remains unchanged if submission fails
No partial submission state is persisted
System logs the submission attempt
Data-at-rest encryption remains in effect

name: Browse inspection reports
preconditions: Site Manager has an active authenticated session with the system.
trigger: Site Manager initiates a request to view inspection reports.

main_scenario.sentence: Site Manager initiates a browse request, optionally specifying site and date filters.
System retrieves the inspection reports that match the provided filters.
System returns the filtered report list to the Site Manager within three seconds.
Site Manager identifies a report of interest from the returned list.

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: Site Manager provides an invalid date filter

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that the date filter is invalid.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System encounters a data retrieval error

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that the report list cannot be retrieved due to a temporary service issue.

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: System does not return the list within three seconds

handling_steps.sentence: System returns the report list after the delay.

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: No inspection reports match the requested filters

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that no reports were found for the given criteria.

success_guarantee: Site Manager receives a list of inspection reports that satisfy the requested site and date filters.
minimal_guarantee: The system does not disclose reports to unauthorized actors.
The Site Manager's session remains active.
No partial or inconsistent report data is presented to the Site Manager.

name: View inspection report photos
preconditions: Site Manager is authenticated and has access to inspection reports.
trigger: Site Manager selects an inspection report to view.

main_scenario.sentence: System retrieves the selected inspection report and its associated photos.
System displays the photos to the Site Manager.

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: System cannot retrieve photos due to a service error

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that the photos cannot be displayed.

extensions.label: 1b
extensions.condition: The selected inspection report has no photos attached

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that no photos are available for this report.

success_guarantee: System records that the report photos were viewed.
minimal_guarantee: System does not modify any inspection report data.
System maintains the confidentiality of inspection report information.

name: Download inspection report PDF
preconditions: Site Manager is authenticated and authorized to access inspection reports
trigger: Site Manager initiates a request to download the PDF summary of a selected inspection report

main_scenario.sentence: Site Manager selects an inspection report for which a PDF summary is desired
System retrieves the PDF summary associated with the selected inspection report
System provides the PDF summary to the Site Manager for download

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: PDF summary does not exist for the selected inspection report

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that the PDF summary is unavailable

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: System encounters an error while retrieving the PDF summary

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the Site Manager of a technical problem and suggests retrying later

success_guarantee: Site Manager receives a complete PDF summary of the selected inspection report
System records that the PDF was downloaded
minimal_guarantee: No incomplete or corrupted PDF is delivered
System maintains security and integrity of inspection data

name: Flag inspection report for follow‑up
preconditions: Site Manager is authenticated to the system
trigger: Site Manager initiates the flagging of an inspection report

main_scenario.sentence: Site Manager selects the inspection report to flag
System records the report as requiring follow-up

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: The selected inspection report cannot be found

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager that the report was not found

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: System encounters an error while recording the follow-up flag

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Site Manager of the error

success_guarantee: The inspection report is marked as requiring follow-up
minimal_guarantee: No follow-up flag is persisted if the operation fails
System remains available for other actions

name: View follow‑up requests
preconditions: Field Engineer possesses a valid user account in the system
trigger: Field Engineer initiates sign-in to the application

main_scenario.sentence: Field Engineer initiates sign-in
System authenticates the engineer
System retrieves follow-up requests assigned to the engineer
System presents the retrieved follow-up requests to the engineer

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: credentials are invalid

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the engineer that authentication has failed

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: system cannot retrieve follow-up requests due to an internal error

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the engineer that follow-up requests cannot be displayed at this time

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: no follow-up requests are assigned to the engineer

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the engineer that there are no follow-up requests

success_guarantee: The engineer has been presented with the complete set of follow-up requests assigned to them at the time of sign-in
minimal_guarantee: The sign-in attempt is recorded and no follow-up request data is disclosed if retrieval fails
The system remains secure and available for subsequent attempts

name: Manage engineer accounts
preconditions: Administrator is authenticated to the system
trigger: Administrator initiates a request to create, modify, or deactivate a field-engineer account

main_scenario.sentence: Administrator provides the operation type (create, modify, deactivate) and the required engineer account data
System validates the supplied data against business rules
System executes the requested operation on the engineer account
System notifies the administrator that the operation completed successfully

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: validation error is detected

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator of the validation error
Administrator supplies corrected data

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: system error prevents completing the operation

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator of the error
Administrator decides to abort the request

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: administrator cancels the request before completion

handling_steps.sentence: System acknowledges the cancellation

success_guarantee: The engineer account is created, modified, or deactivated as requested
The administrator receives confirmation of the successful operation
minimal_guarantee: No partial changes are persisted
The system remains in a consistent state
Any attempted operation is either fully applied or not applied
An audit record of the attempt is retained

name: Assign engineers to sites
preconditions: Administrator has permission to assign engineers to sites
trigger: Administrator initiates the assignment of an engineer to a site

main_scenario.sentence: Administrator identifies the engineer to assign
Administrator identifies the site for assignment
System records the assignment of the engineer to the site
System confirms the assignment to the administrator

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: Engineer identifier is not recognized

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator that the engineer is unknown

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Site identifier is not recognized

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator that the site is unknown

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: System encounters an error while recording the assignment

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator of the recording error

extensions.label: 3b
extensions.condition: Engineer is already assigned to the site

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator that the engineer is already assigned

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: Administrator cancels the operation

handling_steps.sentence: System stops processing the assignment

success_guarantee: Engineer is recorded as assigned to the site
Administrator receives confirmation of the assignment
minimal_guarantee: No assignment is persisted if the use case fails
System maintains data integrity and security for any processed information

name: Perform nightly backup of inspection data
preconditions: The system has generated the day's inspection reports and associated photos.
trigger: The nightly schedule triggers the backup process.

main_scenario.sentence: System initiates the nightly backup because the schedule indicates it is time.
System selects the day's inspection reports and associated photos.
System packages the selected reports and photos into a backup bundle.
System transmits the backup bundle to Backup Storage Service.
System includes retention metadata indicating a five-year retention period.
System ensures the backup is stored in a manner that remains intact and accessible after any redeployment.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Inspection reports or photos are not available

handling_steps.sentence: System records the missing data condition and aborts the backup.

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: Transmission to Backup Storage Service fails

handling_steps.sentence: System records the transmission failure and aborts the backup.

extensions.label: 5a
extensions.condition: Retention metadata cannot be attached

handling_steps.sentence: System records the metadata attachment failure and aborts the backup.

extensions.label: *a
extensions.condition: No new inspection data exists for the day

handling_steps.sentence: System determines that there is no new data and skips backup transmission.

success_guarantee: Backup Storage Service has received and stored the backup bundle.
The backup is retained for five years.
The backup remains intact and accessible after any redeployment.
System records that the backup was completed for the day.
minimal_guarantee: No partial or corrupted backup is left in the system.
Existing backups remain unchanged.
System continues to enforce any configured retention policies.
